name: KALLAX shelving unit, white, 77x41 cm
material: Particle- and fibreboard with honeycomb paper filling (100% recycled paper), Paper foil, Printed and embossed acrylic paint, Plastic edging

construction: Panels are particleboard/fibreboard skins over a paper honeycomb core. Screws into the panel faces barely hold. To mount anything (casters, a post, a top), bolt right through with large washers, or sandwich the unit between plywood plates and fasten to those.
